ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on dressing? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on dressing to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on dressing.
   C. Say Hadith on dressing has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on dressing with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

   C. Use Twahara to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Twahara has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Stories of Prophets:? (1 mark)
   A. Say Stories of Prophets: has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Stories of Prophets: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stories of Prophets:.
   D. Use Stories of Prophets: to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Hajj? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hajj has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Hajj to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah.
   B. Say Selected Surah has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Selected Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

12. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

13. Which response best shows understanding of Taqwa? (1 mark)

15. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

----
